paragraphs.text: DSH plugin: a /clear command that empties one conversation's model context while keeping the session
English | 中文
# dsh-clear-command

Local DSH bundle: a `/clear` command that empties one conversation's **model
context** while keeping
the session itself.
## What it adds

- One Host row that registers the global command `clear`, so `/clear` appears in
every composed comm

and surface (Web composer slash menu, CLI) for every
session.
## Behaviour

- `/clear` clears the conversation's model-visible history: the agent no longer
sees any earlier mes

sage, and its next request starts from the system prompt
plus one marker line.
- The **session is un

touched**: same session id, title, workspace membership,
sidebar position, and a complete durable lo

g. This is a clear, not a delete,
and not a new session.
- The clear is one positional surface repla

cement written into the session log —
the mechanism `/compact` uses — so it survives reloads and rep

lays
deterministically.
- Because the Web transcript is derived from append-origin log events, the
e

arlier messages remain readable on screen and in the log; only what the model
sees is emptied.
- `/c

lear` runs on the agent's idle phase (`runMaintenance`, the same
reservation manual compaction uses)

: while a turn, a queued wake, or another
maintenance task owns the agent, the command reports that

and changes nothing.
- The invocation is recorded in the session log as the ordinary
`command/run` /

`command/done` pair, so the result appears as a command row in
the transcript.
## Notes and limits

- The leading `system/message` surface node is preserved, because it is the
agent's instructions; ev

erything after it is shadowed.
- The marker line is English (`[Earlier conversation cleared by the u

ser; …]`)
because it enters the model's context, while the command's own user-facing copy
is Simplif

ied Chinese, matching the bundle's shipped UI language.
- Nothing here touches archived sessions, ot
her sessions, or their files.
## Files

- `index.js` — the whole plugin: command registration plus the surface
replacement.
- `cordis.patch.

yml` — inserts the single Host row.
- `locale/{en,zh}.json` — Plugin Manager display metadata.
- `ic

on.svg` — Plugin Manager artwork.
- `test/clear-contract.mjs` — offline contract test. It replays a

real session
log (`zstdcat` a `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v*.jsonl.zstd`) into a detached
`Session`,

applies exactly the range and append `index.js` performs, and
prints the resulting surface and deri

ved model messages:
`node test/clear-contract.mjs <log.jsonl.zstd>`.
## Development

The profile links this directory (`link:` in the profile's `package.json`).
Host code is loaded by t

he Loader, so a change needs the row to be reloaded
(profile restart), unlike the client half of `ds

h-split-workspaces`, which
`dsh-client-hmr` reloads on edit.
